about: App preview 1 (about 16 s; Apple's minimum is 15 s): the whole flow, fast. Cut from the 2026-11-14 screen recording; skips Control Center at the start, the white flash while the map loads after Resume, and the street-level driving close-ups. The crop removes the status bar, recording indicator and AssistiveTouch button.
